thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated request QPS for org=axonlabs detected by rl-protector (threshold 1.5x). Token rejection rate increasing, 5xx starting at edge. Auto-created incident #INC-2023-AXN.
marta: acked. oncall -> @sre-oncall can you triage? seeing customer chat from Sam CS.
sre-oncall: on it. pulling metrics now, starting live triage. tagging @ajay for rate-control ops.
ben: saw TTL spike on prefix cache for axonlabs, KV hit drop to 20%. Could be bursty replay.
sre-oncall: confirmed QPS ~3.8x baseline for last 6m, error ratio 4.2% and rising. We should apply an emergency org RL drop to protect platform.
ajay: agree. propose temporary soft cap: org_rate_limit -> 0.5x (from 1.0x) and enable per-route shaping for heavy endpoints.
sam-cs: I messaged Axon CS lead, they say it's a traffic test but can't throttle from their side. Need minimal impact on important customer flows.
eli: adding runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/rl-emergency (see steps 1-6).
sre-oncall: executing change (will do canary across us-west-2 first).
ajay: command I'm about to run:
```
# emergency org rate adjust
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/api/orgs/axonlabs/rate-limit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"factor":0.5,"reason":"emergency spike"}'
```

ajay: applying canary now to 2 nodes in us-west-2. monitoring.
ben: also disabling non-essential realtime hooks for axonlabs until stable to reduce fanout.
sam-cs: noted, letting customer know we've applied a temporary protective limit and will update in 30m.
marta: add SLO-owner and legal for visibility? (reacts :eyes:)
eli: SLOs notified via paging. legal on standby per enterprise playbook.
sre-oncall: canary looks good — error rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.6% in canary region, token rejections down. rolling to global.
ajay: global rollout executed. CLI diff:
```
PATCH /api/orgs/axonlabs/rate-limit
- factor: 1.0
+ factor: 0.5
```

ben: realtime hooks disabled. KV cache warming applied for critical prefixes.
sam-cs: customer confirmed lower error rates on their side, appreciation noted.
marta: what about billing/quotas? will this cause unexpected billing credits?
eli: we'll tag this as emergency mitigation; finance will be looped for postmortem credits if needed.
ajay: setting automatic reversion in 60m if stable, otherwise we'll plan phased bump.
sre-oncall: monitoring charts: QPS trending back to baseline, p95 latency stable. no new pager alerts.
ben: leaving a note: make this change idempotent and log request id: rreq-9a1b.
marta: thanks team. assign follow-ups: - postmortem + customer comms (Sam CS) - billing review (finance) - RL tuning review (Ajay/Ben).
sam-cs: I'll craft a short customer note and sync with Axon lead.
eli: incident-bot: INC-2023-AXN resolved (mitigation in place). root cause TBD — follow-up in postmortem.
sre-oncall: closing on-call handoff, handing to daytime rotation. leaving runbook checklist done.
marta: great work, keeping monitoring for next 2 hours. (reacts :thumbsup:)
